GOOD TO KNOW

A few things you might be wondering.

Is CuePrompt really free?

Yes. The editor, Smart Follow, steady scrolling, mirror modes, fullscreen, the script library and browser recording are free, with no time limits and no account. The AI writer is optional and uses your own API key.

Are my scripts private?

Your scripts are stored in this browser and recordings are created on your device; CuePrompt has no server that receives them. Two exceptions you control: Smart Follow sends microphone audio to your browser's speech service, and the AI writer sends the text you choose to the AI provider you configure. Clearing browser data removes your library, so export a backup now and then.

How does Smart Follow work?

Smart Follow uses your browser's built-in speech recognition and scrolls to the words you just said. It tolerates skipped words and ad-libs, and it waits when you stop talking. Chrome, Edge and Safari send the audio to their own online speech service (Google, Microsoft or Apple), so it needs a connection that can reach that service. Firefox doesn't support it yet; Steady mode works everywhere.

Can I use it on my phone?

Yes. CuePrompt works in mobile, tablet and desktop browsers, including fullscreen with on-screen controls. Camera recording needs HTTPS plus camera and microphone permission; support varies by browser.

How do I record and download my video?

Choose Camera & record, allow access and press Record. After a 3-2-1 countdown the script starts. Press Stop to review the take, then download it (MP4 or WebM, depending on your browser) or retake it. The script is not burned into the video.

Can I use it with a physical teleprompter?

Yes. Turn on Mirror text for beam-splitter glass, or Vertical mirror for rigs that flip the image, then go fullscreen.

How does the AI writer work?

Paste an API key for any OpenAI-compatible service and set its base URL; the default is Alibaba Qwen (DashScope), which works from mainland China. The key is stored only in this browser and requests go straight from your browser to that provider. CuePrompt never sees, stores or ships a key.
